combined_action_delta_router_v108.next_action: If v10.8 improves over v10.7, split v10.7 other_failure and preserve the combined router as the no-GPU baseline. If it does not, keep v10.7 as an action source but do not add more combination heuristics.

constrained_repair_queue_v83.interpretation: The typed scorer alone is not a selector.  The best current shape is a constrained repair queue: preserve retrieval precision, then use typed obligations and risk flags to diversify the tail.

full_goal_snapshot_witness_v123.interpretation: Full proof-state snapshots test whether the controller's emitted bundles create role-compatible local side conditions rather than only broad action success. guarded_filter_v53.interpretation: The filter is allowed to steer local Lean work only. It is not a proof signal, not a GPU-spend trigger, and not an autoresearch loop trigger.

hybrid_repair_router_v84.interpretation: The current best no-training router shape is hybrid: retrieval owns top precision, typed scoring keeps repair-shaped adapters in the tail, and set-cover prevents one role family from dominating. kernel_shape_feature_probe_v93.interpretation: This tests cheap typed/kernel-shape proxies before training.  A positive result should be treated as feature-design evidence only; v9.0 structural occlusion remains the GPU gate.

label_blind_hard_decoy_audit_v92.interpretation: The label leak is closed only if the static check passes.  A hybrid advantage here is useful only as tail-routing evidence; v9.0 structural occlusion still controls GPU eligibility.

lean_environment_type_extractor_v95.interpretation: Lean environment extraction gives elaborated type strings for repair declarations.  This is still weaker than kernel AST/dependency tracing, but stronger than regex signature windows.

literature_positioning_v85.next_test: Freeze a 12-row endpoint-occluded repair benchmark with actual declaration pools and compare: retrieval/BM25 baseline, typed-only tail, and hybrid repair-router.
